envelope.description: Git op table: the family builder and the extension of an existing tool

body.title: Git op table: the family builder and the extension of an existing tool
body.summary: Add src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/op-table.ts with GitOpSpec, buildGitFamilyTool and extendGitTool: flat input schema with an op enum built from the gh field helpers, output union with a literal op, rules that refuse fields an op does not take, ref and path checks, stdin delivery through runShellBytes, cut-output and union checks, the per-op approval class (fixed or a function of the input), time limits and typed failures. No tool uses it yet. Unit tests with a stand-in git.
acceptanceChecks: buildGitFamilyTool throws at build time for a duplicate op, an op without a class, a stdin op without a stdin field and two ops that disagree about a shared field
A field the op does not take and a value outside its pattern are refused before any approval request is built
A cut stdout is a rejected failure whose partial text is not returned, and a result outside the op's answer member is a schema-mismatch failure with the original text kept
A stdin delivery error is a failure and no answer is parsed
extendGitTool keeps every existing input valid with the same result and class, and throws for a name or field collision
